title: Parseval identity for the sign lift of a Boolean function
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean-valued function, and let $g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be its $\pm 1$ lift $g(x) = (-1)^{f(x)}$. Writing $\hat g(S) = \E[g\,\chi_S]$ for the Fourier coefficient of $g$ at $S$, where $\chi_S(x) = \prod_{i \in S}(-1)^{x_i}$ and the expectation is over $x$ uniform on $\{0,1\}^n$, one has
\[
  \sum_{S \subseteq [n]} \hat g(S)^2 = 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a function from the Boolean cube {0,1}^n to {0,1} (Bool-valued)
